scope: 3 newly recognized Ability components, 3 fully supported current ME5-5 Mew ex prints. Prior supported programs and metadata unchanged.
source: Rainier English card text included verbatim per component; conversion input matched by stable card ID.

ruleReferences.usedFor: Official Memory Helix Bench Mew can use Dimensional Hand from a Benched Alakazam ex; actual Mew is still the attack source.
Night Mine tests actual Mew Tera status, not the provider; Tool/Ability granted attacks are not owned printed attacks and cannot be borrowed.
Memory Helix does not inherit Bloodmoon Ursaluna ex provider Ability cost reduction; actual Mew pays the selected printed cost.

Analogous All-Mighty ruling permits payable borrowing of Zoroark Foul Play, then normal secondary copy selection without paying the final attack cost. Memory Helix uses the same printed payable-attack semantics; unrelated unimplemented recursive-copy behavior remains explicitly gated.

Official Memory Helix Round ruling: borrowing usability never makes Mew own the printed attack for attack-name counting. Regression uses the actual current Round-40 component with one printed provider and two Mew; damage remains 40.
